<script>
  (function () {
    function patchButtons(root = document) {
      root.querySelectorAll('a.book-demo-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = null;               // zdejmuje inline handler w JS
        btn.removeAttribute("onclick");   // zdejmuje atrybut
        btn.setAttribute("href", "/book-a-demo");
        btn.setAttribute("target", "_self");
      });
    }

    // 1) od razu
    patchButtons();

    // 2) po pełnym załadowaniu (często w Webflow elementy “dojeżdżają” później)
    window.addEventListener("load", function () {
      patchButtons();
    });

    // 3) jeśli coś dynamicznie podmienia DOM (navbar, symbol, itp.) – obserwuj zmiany
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
      patchButtons();
    });
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    // 4) i najważniejsze: przechwytuj klik zanim dojdzie do innych handlerów
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      const a = e.target.closest("a.book-demo-btn");
      if (!a) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      window.location.assign("/book-a-demo");
    }, true);
  })();
</script>

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img <script>
// Get all .integration-tooltip elements
const tooltips = document.querySelectorAll('.integration_tooltip');

// Iterate over all .integration-tooltip elements
tooltips.forEach((tooltip) => {
  // Get the parent for the current .integration-tooltip element
  const parent = tooltip.parentElement;

  // Add a hover event listener to the parent
  parent.addEventListener('mouseover', () => {
    // Get the height of the current .integration-tooltip element
    const tooltipHeight = -tooltip.offsetHeight;

    // Set the top style value to the height value - 10

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
 
  // === CONFIG ===========================================================
  // Hosts that sit behind the CloudFront/Lambda trailing-slash setup.
  // Only links pointing to these hosts get a trailing slash.
  // Other subdomains (app., help., go., etc.) are intentionally left
  // untouched, because they are served differently and adding a slash
  // there could cause a 404.
  var INTERNAL_HOSTS = ["survicate.com", "www.survicate.com"];
 
  // File extensions that must NOT get a trailing slash (real files, not pages).
  var FILE_EXT = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|zip|rar|7z|gz|txt|rtf|jpe?g|png|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|bmp|tiff?|mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot|map)$/i;
 
  // Protocols / hrefs we never touch.
  var SKIP_HREF = /^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#)/i;
  // ======================================================================
 
  function needsSlash(url) {
    var path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "" || path.charAt(path.length - 1) === "/") return false; // already OK
    var last = path.split("/").pop();
    if (FILE_EXT.test(last)) return false; // it's a file
    return true;
  }
 
  function fixLink(a) {
    if (a.getAttribute("data-tslash") === "1") return; // already processed
    var href = a.getAttribute("href");
    if (!href || SKIP_HREF.test(href)) return;
 
    var url;
    try { url = new URL(href, window.location.href); } // also resolves relative links
    catch (e) { return; }
 
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") return;
    if (INTERNAL_HOSTS.indexOf(url.hostname) === -1) return; // external / other subdomain
    if (!needsSlash(url)) { a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1"); return; }
 
    var newPath = url.pathname + "/";
 
    // Preserve the original form of the link (relative vs absolute).
    var isAbsolute = /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href);
    if (isAbsolute) {
      url.pathname = newPath;
      a.setAttribute("href", url.toString());
    } else {
      // slash goes BEFORE the ?query and #hash
      a.setAttribute("href", newPath + url.search + url.hash);
    }
    a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1");
  }
 
  function run(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) fixLink(links[i]);
  }
 
  function init() {
    run(document);
 
    // Catches links added after page load
    // (CMS "Load more", pagination, Finsweet, filters, etc.)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {

        for (var m = 0; m < mutations.length; m++) {
          var nodes = mutations[m].addedNodes;

            var node = nodes[n];
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue; // elements only
            if (node.tagName === "A") fixLink(node);
            else if (node.querySelectorAll) run(node);
          }
        }
      });

    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {

  }

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
 
  // === CONFIG ===========================================================
  // Hosts that sit behind the CloudFront/Lambda trailing-slash setup.
  // Only links pointing to these hosts get a trailing slash.
  // Other subdomains (app., help., go., etc.) are intentionally left
  // untouched, because they are served differently and adding a slash
  // there could cause a 404.
  var INTERNAL_HOSTS = ["survicate.com", "www.survicate.com"];
 
  // File extensions that must NOT get a trailing slash (real files, not pages).
  var FILE_EXT = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|zip|rar|7z|gz|txt|rtf|jpe?g|png|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|bmp|tiff?|mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot|map)$/i;
 
  // Protocols / hrefs we never touch.
  var SKIP_HREF = /^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#)/i;
  // ======================================================================
 
  function needsSlash(url) {
    var path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "" || path.charAt(path.length - 1) === "/") return false; // already OK
    var last = path.split("/").pop();
    if (FILE_EXT.test(last)) return false; // it's a file
    return true;
  }
 
  function fixLink(a) {
    if (a.getAttribute("data-tslash") === "1") return; // already processed
    var href = a.getAttribute("href");
    if (!href || SKIP_HREF.test(href)) return;
 
    var url;
    try { url = new URL(href, window.location.href); } // also resolves relative links
    catch (e) { return; }
 
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") return;
    if (INTERNAL_HOSTS.indexOf(url.hostname) === -1) return; // external / other subdomain
    if (!needsSlash(url)) { a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1"); return; }
 
    var newPath = url.pathname + "/";
 
    // Preserve the original form of the link (relative vs absolute).
    var isAbsolute = /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href);
    if (isAbsolute) {
      url.pathname = newPath;
      a.setAttribute("href", url.toString());
    } else {
      // slash goes BEFORE the ?query and #hash
      a.setAttribute("href", newPath + url.search + url.hash);
    }
    a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1");
  }
 
  function run(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) fixLink(links[i]);
  }
 
  function init() {
    run(document);
 
    // Catches links added after page load
    // (CMS "Load more", pagination, Finsweet, filters, etc.)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {
      var obs = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        for (var m = 0; m < mutations.length; m++) {
          var nodes = mutations[m].addedNodes;
          for (var n = 0; n < nodes.length; n++) {
            var node = nodes[n];
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue; // elements only
            if (node.tagName === "A") fixLink(node);
            else if (node.querySelectorAll) run(node);
          }
        }
      });
      obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img <script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

<!-- ====================================================================
     TRAILING SLASH FIX — internal links
     Paste into: Webflow → Site Settings → Custom Code → Footer Code
     (before </body>, so it runs on the WHOLE site = global solution)
     ==================================================================== -->
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
 
  // === CONFIG ===========================================================
  // Hosts that sit behind the CloudFront/Lambda trailing-slash setup.
  // Only links pointing to these hosts get a trailing slash.
  // Other subdomains (app., help., go., etc.) are intentionally left
  // untouched, because they are served differently and adding a slash
  // there could cause a 404.
  var INTERNAL_HOSTS = ["survicate.com", "www.survicate.com"];
 
  // File extensions that must NOT get a trailing slash (real files, not pages).
  var FILE_EXT = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|zip|rar|7z|gz|txt|rtf|jpe?g|png|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|bmp|tiff?|mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot|map)$/i;
 
  // Protocols / hrefs we never touch.
  var SKIP_HREF = /^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#)/i;
  // ======================================================================
 
  function needsSlash(url) {
    var path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "" || path.charAt(path.length - 1) === "/") return false; // already OK
    var last = path.split("/").pop();
    if (FILE_EXT.test(last)) return false; // it's a file
    return true;
  }
 
  function fixLink(a) {
    if (a.getAttribute("data-tslash") === "1") return; // already processed
    var href = a.getAttribute("href");
    if (!href || SKIP_HREF.test(href)) return;
 
    var url;
    try { url = new URL(href, window.location.href); } // also resolves relative links
    catch (e) { return; }
 
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") return;
    if (INTERNAL_HOSTS.indexOf(url.hostname) === -1) return; // external / other subdomain
    if (!needsSlash(url)) { a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1"); return; }
 
    var newPath = url.pathname + "/";
 
    // Preserve the original form of the link (relative vs absolute).
    var isAbsolute = /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href);
    if (isAbsolute) {
      url.pathname = newPath;
      a.setAttribute("href", url.toString());
    } else {
      // slash goes BEFORE the ?query and #hash
      a.setAttribute("href", newPath + url.search + url.hash);
    }
    a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1");
  }
 
  function run(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) fixLink(links[i]);
  }
 
  function init() {
    run(document);
 
    // Catches links added after page load
    // (CMS "Load more", pagination, Finsweet, filters, etc.)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {
      var obs = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        for (var m = 0; m < mutations.length; m++) {
          var nodes = mutations[m].addedNodes;
          for (var n = 0; n < nodes.length; n++) {
            var node = nodes[n];
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue; // elements only
            if (node.tagName === "A") fixLink(node);
            else if (node.querySelectorAll) run(node);
          }
        }
      });
      obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  }
 
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    function patchButtons(root = document) {
      root.querySelectorAll('a.book-demo-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = null;               // zdejmuje inline handler w JS
        btn.removeAttribute("onclick");   // zdejmuje atrybut
        btn.setAttribute("href", "/book-a-demo");
        btn.setAttribute("target", "_self");
      });
    }

    // 1) od razu
    patchButtons();

    // 2) po pełnym załadowaniu (często w Webflow elementy “dojeżdżają” później)
    window.addEventListener("load", function () {
      patchButtons();
    });

    // 3) jeśli coś dynamicznie podmienia DOM (navbar, symbol, itp.) – obserwuj zmiany
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
      patchButtons();
    });
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    // 4) i najważniejsze: przechwytuj klik zanim dojdzie do innych handlerów
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      const a = e.target.closest("a.book-demo-btn");
      if (!a) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      window.location.assign("/book-a-demo");
    }, true);
  })();
</script>

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img <script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
 
  // === CONFIG ===========================================================
  // Hosts that sit behind the CloudFront/Lambda trailing-slash setup.
  // Only links pointing to these hosts get a trailing slash.
  // Other subdomains (app., help., go., etc.) are intentionally left
  // untouched, because they are served differently and adding a slash
  // there could cause a 404.
  var INTERNAL_HOSTS = ["survicate.com", "www.survicate.com"];
 
  // File extensions that must NOT get a trailing slash (real files, not pages).
  var FILE_EXT = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|zip|rar|7z|gz|txt|rtf|jpe?g|png|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|bmp|tiff?|mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot|map)$/i;
 
  // Protocols / hrefs we never touch.
  var SKIP_HREF = /^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#)/i;
  // ======================================================================
 
  function needsSlash(url) {
    var path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "" || path.charAt(path.length - 1) === "/") return false; // already OK
    var last = path.split("/").pop();
    if (FILE_EXT.test(last)) return false; // it's a file
    return true;
  }
 
  function fixLink(a) {
    if (a.getAttribute("data-tslash") === "1") return; // already processed
    var href = a.getAttribute("href");
    if (!href || SKIP_HREF.test(href)) return;
 
    var url;
    try { url = new URL(href, window.location.href); } // also resolves relative links
    catch (e) { return; }
 
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") return;
    if (INTERNAL_HOSTS.indexOf(url.hostname) === -1) return; // external / other subdomain
    if (!needsSlash(url)) { a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1"); return; }
 
    var newPath = url.pathname + "/";
 
    // Preserve the original form of the link (relative vs absolute).
    var isAbsolute = /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href);
    if (isAbsolute) {
      url.pathname = newPath;
      a.setAttribute("href", url.toString());
    } else {
      // slash goes BEFORE the ?query and #hash
      a.setAttribute("href", newPath + url.search + url.hash);
    }
    a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1");
  }
 
  function run(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) fixLink(links[i]);
  }
 
  function init() {
    run(document);
 
    // Catches links added after page load
    // (CMS "Load more", pagination, Finsweet, filters, etc.)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {
      var obs = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        for (var m = 0; m < mutations.length; m++) {
          var nodes = mutations[m].addedNodes;
          for (var n = 0; n < nodes.length; n++) {
            var node = nodes[n];
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue; // elements only
            if (node.tagName === "A") fixLink(node);
            else if (node.querySelectorAll) run(node);
          }
        }
      });
      obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  }
 
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    function patchButtons(root = document) {
      root.querySelectorAll('a.book-demo-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = null;               // zdejmuje inline handler w JS
        btn.removeAttribute("onclick");   // zdejmuje atrybut
        btn.setAttribute("href", "/book-a-demo");
        btn.setAttribute("target", "_self");
      });
    }

    // 1) od razu
    patchButtons();

    // 2) po pełnym załadowaniu (często w Webflow elementy “dojeżdżają” później)
    window.addEventListener("load", function () {
      patchButtons();
    });

    // 3) jeśli coś dynamicznie podmienia DOM (navbar, symbol, itp.) – obserwuj zmiany
    const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
      patchButtons();
    });
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    // 4) i najważniejsze: przechwytuj klik zanim dojdzie do innych handlerów
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {

      if (!a) return;

      window.location.assign("/book-a-demo");
    }, true);
  })();

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img const tooltips = document.querySelectorAll('.integration_tooltip');

tooltips.forEach((tooltip) => {
  // Get the parent for the current .integration-tooltip element
  const parent = tooltip.parentElement;

  // Add a hover event listener to the parent
  parent.addEventListener('mouseover', () => {
    // Get the height of the current .integration-tooltip element
    const tooltipHeight = -tooltip.offsetHeight;

    // Set the top style value to the height value - 10
    tooltip.style.top = `${tooltipHeight - 10}px`;
  });

  // Remove the top style value after the hover ends
  parent.addEventListener('mouseout', () => {
    tooltip.style.top = '';
  });

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
 
  // === CONFIG ===========================================================
  // Hosts that sit behind the CloudFront/Lambda trailing-slash setup.
  // Only links pointing to these hosts get a trailing slash.
  // Other subdomains (app., help., go., etc.) are intentionally left
  // untouched, because they are served differently and adding a slash
  // there could cause a 404.
  var INTERNAL_HOSTS = ["survicate.com", "www.survicate.com"];
 
  // File extensions that must NOT get a trailing slash (real files, not pages).
  var FILE_EXT = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|zip|rar|7z|gz|txt|rtf|jpe?g|png|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|bmp|tiff?|mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot|map)$/i;
 
  // Protocols / hrefs we never touch.
  var SKIP_HREF = /^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#)/i;
  // ======================================================================
 
  function needsSlash(url) {
    var path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "" || path.charAt(path.length - 1) === "/") return false; // already OK
    var last = path.split("/").pop();
    if (FILE_EXT.test(last)) return false; // it's a file
    return true;
  }
 
  function fixLink(a) {
    if (a.getAttribute("data-tslash") === "1") return; // already processed
    var href = a.getAttribute("href");
    if (!href || SKIP_HREF.test(href)) return;
 
    var url;
    try { url = new URL(href, window.location.href); } // also resolves relative links
    catch (e) { return; }
 
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") return;
    if (INTERNAL_HOSTS.indexOf(url.hostname) === -1) return; // external / other subdomain
    if (!needsSlash(url)) { a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1"); return; }
 
    var newPath = url.pathname + "/";
 
    // Preserve the original form of the link (relative vs absolute).
    var isAbsolute = /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href);
    if (isAbsolute) {
      url.pathname = newPath;
      a.setAttribute("href", url.toString());
    } else {
      // slash goes BEFORE the ?query and #hash
      a.setAttribute("href", newPath + url.search + url.hash);
    }
    a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1");
  }
 
  function run(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) fixLink(links[i]);
  }
 
  function init() {
    run(document);
 
    // Catches links added after page load
    // (CMS "Load more", pagination, Finsweet, filters, etc.)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {

        for (var m = 0; m < mutations.length; m++) {
          var nodes = mutations[m].addedNodes;
          for (var n = 0; n < nodes.length; n++) {
            var node = nodes[n];
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue; // elements only
            if (node.tagName === "A") fixLink(node);
            else if (node.querySelectorAll) run(node);
          }
        }
      });

    }

  } else {

(function () {
  const IDS = {
    DEFAULT: 'client-logo-default',
    PL: 'client-logo-pl',
    BRAZE: 'client-logo-braze',
  };

  function showOnly(targetId) {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById('client-logo-wrapper');
    const els = {
      [IDS.DEFAULT]: document.getElementById(IDS.DEFAULT),
      [IDS.PL]:      document.getElementById(IDS.PL),
      [IDS.BRAZE]:   document.getElementById(IDS.BRAZE),
    };

    // Remove all elements except the selected one
    Object.entries(els).forEach(([id, el]) => {
      if (el && id !== targetId) {
        el.remove(); // PHYSICAL REMOVAL FROM DOM
      }
    });

    // Add .is-active class to the selected element
    const target = els[targetId];
    if (target) target.classList.add('is-active');

    // Reveal wrapper
    if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('ready');
  }

  // URL override for testing: ?geo=pl | default | braze
  const usp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const geoOverride = (usp.get('geo') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (geoOverride === 'braze')   { showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);   return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'pl')      { showOnly(IDS.PL);      return; }
  if (geoOverride === 'default') { showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT); return; }

  // Braze page – force Braze regardless of geo
  const path = (location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (path === '/integrations/braze-survey') {
    showOnly(IDS.BRAZE);
    return;
  }

  // Geolocation (no cache). On error → DEFAULT
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2500);

  fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', {
    signal: controller.signal,
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('HTTP ' + r.status)))
    .then(data => {
      const code = (data && (data.country_code || data.country)) ? (data.country_code || data.country) : '';
      const isPL = String(code).toUpperCase() === 'PL';
      showOnly(isPL ? IDS.PL : IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      showOnly(IDS.DEFAULT);
    })
    .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeout));
})();
</script></div></div></div></div><div class="container_main"><div class="column_wrappper my-20"><div class="column_wrappper_compare"><img <script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const navbarWrapper = document.querySelector('.navbar-wrapper');
  const heroBackground = document.querySelector('.hero_background');
  const infoTopBanner =
    document.querySelector('.info-top-banner') ||
    document.querySelector('.pb-info-top-banner'); // fallback

  const dropdownLists = document.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-list');

  if (!navbarWrapper || !infoTopBanner) return;

  const isBannerVisible = () =>
    getComputedStyle(infoTopBanner).display !== 'none' &&
    infoTopBanner.offsetHeight > 0;

  const navbarBottomViewport = () => navbarWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  const navbarBottomDocument = () => navbarWrapper.offsetTop + navbarWrapper.offsetHeight;

  const positionDropdowns = () => {
    dropdownLists.forEach(list => {
      const pos = getComputedStyle(list).position;
      if (pos === 'fixed') {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomViewport()) - 8 + 'px';
      } else {
        list.style.top = Math.round(navbarBottomDocument()) - 8 + 'px';
      }
      list.style.transform = 'none';
    });
  };

  const syncNavbar = () => {
    const bannerH = infoTopBanner.offsetHeight;
    const y = window.scrollY;

    if (!isBannerVisible()) {
      navbarWrapper.style.top = '0px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = '0';
    } else {
      const offset = Math.max(bannerH - y, 0);
      navbarWrapper.style.top = offset + 'px';
      if (heroBackground) heroBackground.style.marginTop = offset + 'px';
    }

    if (heroBackground) {
      navbarWrapper.style.backgroundColor = getComputedStyle(heroBackground).backgroundColor;
    }

    positionDropdowns();
  };

  syncNavbar();

  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncNavbar();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', syncNavbar);
  new ResizeObserver(syncNavbar).observe(infoTopBanner);
});
</script>

     Paste into: Webflow → Site Settings → Custom Code → Footer Code

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
 
  // === CONFIG ===========================================================
  // Hosts that sit behind the CloudFront/Lambda trailing-slash setup.
  // Only links pointing to these hosts get a trailing slash.
  // Other subdomains (app., help., go., etc.) are intentionally left
  // untouched, because they are served differently and adding a slash
  // there could cause a 404.
  var INTERNAL_HOSTS = ["survicate.com", "www.survicate.com"];
 
  // File extensions that must NOT get a trailing slash (real files, not pages).
  var FILE_EXT = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|zip|rar|7z|gz|txt|rtf|jpe?g|png|gif|svg|webp|avif|ico|bmp|tiff?|mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv|mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|css|js|mjs|json|xml|rss|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot|map)$/i;
 
  // Protocols / hrefs we never touch.
  var SKIP_HREF = /^(mailto:|tel:|sms:|javascript:|data:|blob:|#)/i;
  // ======================================================================
 
  function needsSlash(url) {
    var path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "" || path.charAt(path.length - 1) === "/") return false; // already OK
    var last = path.split("/").pop();
    if (FILE_EXT.test(last)) return false; // it's a file
    return true;
  }
 
  function fixLink(a) {
    if (a.getAttribute("data-tslash") === "1") return; // already processed
    var href = a.getAttribute("href");
    if (!href || SKIP_HREF.test(href)) return;
 
    var url;
    try { url = new URL(href, window.location.href); } // also resolves relative links
    catch (e) { return; }
 
    if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") return;
    if (INTERNAL_HOSTS.indexOf(url.hostname) === -1) return; // external / other subdomain
    if (!needsSlash(url)) { a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1"); return; }
 
    var newPath = url.pathname + "/";
 
    // Preserve the original form of the link (relative vs absolute).
    var isAbsolute = /^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href);
    if (isAbsolute) {
      url.pathname = newPath;
      a.setAttribute("href", url.toString());
    } else {
      // slash goes BEFORE the ?query and #hash
      a.setAttribute("href", newPath + url.search + url.hash);
    }
    a.setAttribute("data-tslash", "1");
  }
 
  function run(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) fixLink(links[i]);
  }
 
  function init() {
    run(document);
 
    // Catches links added after page load
    // (CMS "Load more", pagination, Finsweet, filters, etc.)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {
      var obs = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        for (var m = 0; m < mutations.length; m++) {
          var nodes = mutations[m].addedNodes;
          for (var n = 0; n < nodes.length; n++) {
            var node = nodes[n];
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue; // elements only
            if (node.tagName === "A") fixLink(node);
            else if (node.querySelectorAll) run(node);
          }
        }
      });
      obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  }
 
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
